Free delivery on every order over forty pounds, and every plant comes with a thirty day guarantee.

About the greenhouse

We started Fern & Stone in a rented greenhouse in 2019 with forty cuttings and a secondhand heater. Today three growers look after about two thousand plants, and we still pot every one of them by hand.

We do not use peat, we reuse every pot that customers bring back, and our delivery vans run on electricity.

Questions about a plant? Our growers answer every email within one working day.

Fern & Stone, 12 Market Lane, Bristol. Open Tuesday to Sunday.
